summary: Kerb beside a playing field on Gailey Road, with other cars parked.

drivers.seclusion: West kerb backs onto a large oval and trees. Nearest flats are across the road, 22-24 m from the line.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars parked nose to tail along this kerb, so there is a parking lane to pull into.
drivers.traffic: Moderately busy through road near a junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked here in both images, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Low-lying: lowest point about 5 m elevation
Apartments 11 m from the start of the line, outside the best section
sun_shade: Trees shade the kerb from the west and north-west; open to morning sun over the oval.
cannot_judge: Parking signs or time limits on site

best_section.where: Along the oval fence line, before the corner shops at the north end
